notes: 8-year history from 2018 captures the pre-COVID baseline, 2020 COVID crash, 2022 rate shock, and 2023-2026 AI bull market — sufficient for all stress scenario calibration.
Daily granularity preserved; weekly resampling (Friday close) done client-side for stress scenarios.
Yahoo corporate actions fetched with 10y range to capture full NVDA/TSM split history.

stooq._disabled_note: DISABLED 2026-07: Stooq's CSV endpoint now returns JS-rendered HTML for automated requests (even with the API key) — it is broken as an automated feed. Yahoo (yahoo_events) is the primary price source; this block is retained as a fallback if Stooq's CSV ever works again.

nasdaq_data_link.name: Nasdaq Data Link EOD Prices — backup
nasdaq_data_link.description: Backup if Stooq is unavailable. Free tier: 50 calls/day. Returns OHLCV + Dividend + Split. API key in .env as STOOQ_API_KEY.

yahoo_events.name: Yahoo Finance — OHLCV + Corporate Actions + Adjusted Close
yahoo_events.description: PRIMARY price source (Stooq is broken). OHLCV prices (prices_daily.csv), dividends, splits, and adjusted close via the Yahoo chart endpoint in a single call. Requires a real User-Agent header. Also builds the discrete dividend schedule for the QL dividend curve.

yahoo_history.name: Yahoo Finance — long adjusted-close history (severity anchors)
yahoo_history.description: Daily adjusted closes from 1990 for the book's names that existed then plus the long-history indices (^SOX semis from 1994, ^IXIC, ^GSPC, XLU as the power proxy), for the scenario severity anchors (docs/design/scenario_set_and_ablation_design.md §3.3; mapping in configs/scenariogen/long_history.json). Writes its OWN file — never prices_daily.csv / dividends.csv (a partial yahoo_events ingest clobbers those). Required tickers are fail-loud; the rest are skipped with a warning.
